name_zh: 天下主权法（主权在民/民本激进主义）
domain_categories: 认识论/方法论 / Epistemology / Methodology
经济学/财政学 / Economics / Public Finance
description_zh: 第一步：天下主权确立——用「天下主权法」(M301)追溯政治权力起源于天下公利，确立民本位、君末位的政治合法性逻辑。'有生之初，人各自私也，人各自利也'，君主本为服务天下而设，非天命授予特权。
process_steps: 第一步：天下主权确立——用「天下主权法」(M301)追溯政治权力起源于天下公利，确立民本位、君末位的政治合法性逻辑。'有生之初，人各自私也，人各自利也'，君主本为服务天下而设，非天命授予特权。
famous_quote: 天下为主，君为客；有治法而后有治人；天下之大害者，君而已矣；学问之道，以各人自用得着者为真
definition_en: Tianxia (the people/world) is the fundamental political subject; the ruler is merely a guest and servant of Tianxia. This subverts the traditional 'divine right' logic: not heaven establishes the ruler to govern the people, but the people are primary and the ruler secondary. The 'Origin of the Ruler' chapter argues the ruler was initially established for the benefit of all under heaven, not the reverse. If the ruler treats Tianxia's interests as private property, the rulership itself constitutes a disruption of political order.

name_zh: 治法优先法（制度优先于个人/法治理论）
domain_categories: 认识论/方法论 / Epistemology / Methodology
经济学/财政学 / Economics / Public Finance
description_zh: 第二步：制度优先重构——用「治法优先法」(M302)识别'三代以上之法'（公法）与'一家之法'（私法/非法之法）的本质区别，主张'有治法而后有治人'，以制度框架约束权力而非依赖道德教化。
process_steps: 第二步：制度优先重构——用「治法优先法」(M302)识别'三代以上之法'（公法）与'一家之法'（私法/非法之法）的本质区别，主张'有治法而后有治人'，以制度框架约束权力而非依赖道德教化。
famous_quote: 天下为主，君为客；有治法而后有治人；天下之大害者，君而已矣；学问之道，以各人自用得着者为真
definition_en: Good institutions (zhi fa) take priority over individual virtue (zhi ren). Contrary to the traditional Confucian claim 'there are governing men but no governing laws,' Huang Zongxi argued that the 'non-law laws' of later ages (despotic ordinances) are the true root of disaster. Without sound institutional frameworks, even the most virtuous ruler cannot achieve good governance. This is the first systematic argument in Chinese intellectual history for institutional priority over individual character.

name_zh: 学校议政法（公共领域/协商民主雏形）
domain_categories: 认识论/方法论 / Epistemology / Methodology
经济学/财政学 / Economics / Public Finance
description_zh: 第三步：公共议政建制——用「学校议政法」(M303)将学校转化为政治议政场所，'公其非是于学校'，太学祭酒地位等同宰相，形成制约君权的公共理性空间。
process_steps: 第三步：公共议政建制——用「学校议政法」(M303)将学校转化为政治议政场所，'公其非是于学校'，太学祭酒地位等同宰相，形成制约君权的公共理性空间。
famous_quote: 天下为主，君为客；有治法而后有治人；天下之大害者，君而已矣；学问之道，以各人自用得着者为真
application_examples: 学术界与政治界互动机制
独立媒体与公共舆论功能
definition_en: Schools should not merely be educational institutions but venues for political deliberation. 'All instruments for governing Tianxia must originate from schools.' Schools become public spaces for judging right and wrong and deliberating policy. The Grand Learning's director holds status equivalent to the prime minister, and even the emperor must attend school sessions to participate in discussion. This is the closest conception to a modern parliamentary system in Chinese intellectual history, designing 'public judgment of right and wrong in schools' as an institutional mechanism to check imperial power and realize public rational deliberation.

name_zh: 理气一元法（气本论/反二元论/唯物主义转向）
domain_categories: 认识论/方法论 / Epistemology / Methodology
经济学/财政学 / Economics / Public Finance
description_zh: 第四步：本体论转向——用「理气一元法」(M304)反对程朱'理在气先'，主张'理即是气之理'，确立气本论唯物主义立场。
process_steps: 第四步：本体论转向——用「理气一元法」(M304)反对程朱'理在气先'，主张'理即是气之理'，确立气本论唯物主义立场。
famous_quote: 天下为主，君为客；有治法而后有治人；天下之大害者，君而已矣；学问之道，以各人自用得着者为真
definition_en: Opposing Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucian dualism of 'li prior to qi,' arguing 'li is simply the li of qi'; li cannot exist independently apart from qi. The universe's primordial substance is a single qi in flux, and li is merely qi's operational pattern, not an independent entity. 'The whole cosmos is heart-mind, changeful and unpredictable, necessarily diverse'—heart and qi, li and qi are unified in the material primacy of qi. This stance founded the early modern materialist philosophical turn in China.

name_zh: 一本万殊法（学术多元主义/反同质化）
domain_categories: 认识论/方法论 / Epistemology / Methodology
经济学/财政学 / Economics / Public Finance
description_zh: 第五步：学术生态建构——用「一本万殊法」(M305)承认学术传统多元性，保留'一偏之见'与'相反之论'，反对'以水济水'的同质化。
process_steps: 第五步：学术生态建构——用「一本万殊法」(M305)承认学术传统多元性，保留'一偏之见'与'相反之论'，反对'以水济水'的同质化。
famous_quote: 天下为主，君为客；有治法而后有治人；天下之大害者，君而已矣；学问之道，以各人自用得着者为真
definition_en: Truth (one essence) manifests through countless individualized paths (many manifestations); scholarship should not demand uniform standards. In compiling the 'Ming Ru Xue An,' Huang advocated 'each has partial views and opposing arguments; scholars should pay attention to their differences,' opposing homogenization 'pouring water into water.' Different schools pursue different approaches but all seek the Dao—this is the academic ecology of 'one essence, many manifestations.' This methodology broke through the tradition of 'exclusive devotion to one path' in scholarship.

name_zh: 经世应务法（实用主义/知识服务实践）
domain_categories: 认识论/方法论 / Epistemology / Methodology
经济学/财政学 / Economics / Public Finance
description_zh: 第六步：实践导向确立——用「经世应务法」(M306)以解决现实问题为学问根本目的，'学必原本于经术而后不为蹈虚，必证明于史籍而后足以应务'。
process_steps: 第六步：实践导向确立——用「经世应务法」(M306)以解决现实问题为学问根本目的，'学必原本于经术而后不为蹈虚，必证明于史籍而后足以应务'。
famous_quote: 天下为主，君为客；有治法而后有治人；天下之大害者，君而已矣；学问之道，以各人自用得着者为真
definition_en: The fundamental purpose of learning is 'practical statecraft'—solving real social problems—not empty contemplation of nature and mind. 'Learning must originate from classical studies to avoid empty vacuity, and must be verified through historical records to be sufficient for practical affairs.' Integrating classical research with historical verification, using history to verify classics and classics to guide history, ultimately serving the practical goal of governing and pacifying the world. This is a direct critique of the vacuous scholarship of late Ming Wang school.

name_zh: 史料考辨法（实证考据/跨学科验证）
domain_categories: 认识论/方法论 / Epistemology / Methodology
经济学/财政学 / Economics / Public Finance
description_zh: 第七步：实证考据验证——用「史料考辨法」(M307)运用天文学、历法学等专门知识验证史料真伪，'弹驳参正、去伪存真'。
process_steps: 第七步：实证考据验证——用「史料考辨法」(M307)运用天文学、历法学等专门知识验证史料真伪，'弹驳参正、去伪存真'。
famous_quote: 天下为主，君为客；有治法而后有治人；天下之大害者，君而已矣；学问之道，以各人自用得着者为真
source_text: 《明儒学案》《春秋日食历》《历代甲子考》
definition_en: Using rigorous verification methods to distinguish authentic from spurious sources, opposing blind deference to authority and selective records. 'Official histories take detailed chronology, unofficial histories take proper judgment of right and wrong, family histories prepare genealogical records'—determining selection criteria by source type. Using astronomical calculations to verify Spring and Autumn Annals eclipse records, applying calendrical knowledge to determine the authenticity of the Old Text Shangshu, embodying the 'seeking truth from facts' empirical spirit. Valuing primary sources, opposing 'flattering epitaphs.'

name_zh: 黄宗羲定律法（制度经济学/税制改革悖论）
domain_categories: 认识论/方法论 / Epistemology / Methodology
经济学/财政学 / Economics / Public Finance
description_zh: 第八步：制度规律洞察——用「黄宗羲定律法」(M308)识别税制改革中'积累莫返之害'的循环逻辑。
process_steps: 第八步：制度规律洞察——用「黄宗羲定律法」(M308)识别税制改革中'积累莫返之害'的循环逻辑。
famous_quote: 天下为主，君为客；有治法而后有治人；天下之大害者，君而已矣；学问之道，以各人自用得着者为真
definition_en: The regular pattern whereby tax reform leads to fiscal burden rebound: each simplification and consolidation reform briefly reduces peasant burdens, but new additional taxes soon drive burdens higher than before reform. 'Accumulated harm that cannot be reversed' reveals the internal logic of institutional corruption—rulers do not genuinely concede benefits in tax reform, but rather legitimize hidden exploitation through 'tax-consolidation reform,' then layer new exactions upon it. This pattern transcends its era and applies to analyzing benefit distribution in any institutional change.

name_zh: 夷夏之辨法（文化认同/文化主义而非种族主义）
domain_categories: 认识论/方法论 / Epistemology / Methodology
经济学/财政学 / Economics / Public Finance
description_zh: 第九步：文化认同界定——用「夷夏之辨法」(M309)以文化文明程度而非种族血统区分华夏与夷狄。
process_steps: 第九步：文化认同界定——用「夷夏之辨法」(M309)以文化文明程度而非种族血统区分华夏与夷狄。
famous_quote: 天下为主，君为客；有治法而后有治人；天下之大害者，君而已矣；学问之道，以各人自用得着者为真
definition_en: Using culture (Chinese civilization) rather than racial lineage as the criterion for distinguishing 'Xia' from 'Yi.' 'Since the Three Dynasties, none has devastated Tianxia more than the Yi and Di,' but Huang's 'Yi-Xia distinction' is not mere racism—it emphasizes the advancement and backwardness of civilization. When the Yi possess civilized order, their rule may be accepted; when Xia loses civilization, it becomes equivalent to Yi. This culturalist orientation distinguishes him from narrow nationalism.

name_zh: 会众合一法（归纳综合/知识整合方法论）
domain_categories: 认识论/方法论 / Epistemology / Methodology
经济学/财政学 / Economics / Public Finance
description_zh: 第十步：知识综合整合——用「会众合一法」(M310)从各家全集中'纂要钩玄'提炼核心宗旨，实现'万殊归一本'的学术综合。
process_steps: 第十步：知识综合整合——用「会众合一法」(M310)从各家全集中'纂要钩玄'提炼核心宗旨，实现'万殊归一本'的学术综合。
famous_quote: 天下为主，君为客；有治法而后有治人；天下之大害者，君而已矣；学问之道，以各人自用得着者为真
source_text: 《明儒学案·发凡》《万充宗墓志铭》
definition_en: Respecting each school's 'partial views,' through the inductive method of 'synthesizing the many into one,' extracting shared spirit from diverse academic traditions. Complementary to the 'One Essence Many Manifestations' method: the latter is analytical (seeing difference from commonality), this one is inductive (seeing commonality from difference). In compiling the 'Ming Ru Xue An,' 'from each scholar's complete works, extract the essential threads'—distilling each thinker's core tenets without erasing individuality, yet revealing commonality, achieving the synthesis of 'many manifestations returning to one essence.'

name_zh: 太虚即气法
definition_zh: 以太虚为气的本然状态，否定佛道以空、无以为本体的观点。太虚无形，气之本体；其聚其散，变化之客形尔。宇宙间不存在绝对的'无'或'空'，一切存在都是气的不同形态——聚则为万物，散则归太虚。
definition_en: Taking Tai Xu (Great Void) as the original state of Qi, rejecting Buddhist and Daoist views that take emptiness/nothingness as ontology. Tai Xu is formless, the original substance of Qi; its aggregation and dispersion are transient forms. The universe contains no absolute 'nothingness' or 'emptiness'; all existence is different states of Qi—when aggregated, it becomes myriad things; when dispersed, it returns to Tai Xu.
process_zh: 否定绝对虚无的存在——'知太虚即气，则无无'
确立气为宇宙唯一实体——'太虚不能无气，气不能不聚而为万物'
解释万物生灭为气的聚散变化——'万物不能不散而为太虚'
构建循环本体论框架：太虚→气化→万物→太虚
process_en: Negate absolute nothingness—'Know Tai Xu is Qi, then there is no nothing'
Establish Qi as the sole cosmic substance—'Tai Xu cannot lack Qi, Qi must aggregate to become myriad things'
Explain birth and death as aggregation/dispersion of Qi—'Myriad things must disperse back to Tai Xu'
Construct cyclic ontology framework: Tai Xu → Qi transformation → Myriad things → Tai Xu
modern_applications: 系统思维中的整体性原理
物质守恒与能量转换思考
否定虚无主义世界观
本体论层面的还原分析

name_zh: 一物两体法
name_en: One Thing Two Bodies Method (Dialectical Unity)
definition_zh: 任何事物内部都包含对立面（阴阳），'有两亦一在，无两亦一在'。矛盾不是外在冲突而是内在统一的基础，对立面相互依存、相互转化，构成了事物运动变化的根本动力。
definition_en: Every thing contains opposing forces (Yin-Yang) within—it has two and one, without two there is still one. Contradiction is not external conflict but the foundation of internal unity; opposites interdepend and transform, forming the fundamental driving force of all change.
process_zh: 识别事物内部的对立统一结构
分析对立面的相互依存关系
理解矛盾双方转化的条件与机制
在对立统一中把握事物的运动规律
process_en: Identify the dialectical structure within any thing
Analyze how opposites interdepend on each other
Understand conditions and mechanisms of contradictory transformation
Grasp the movement laws through unity of opposites
modern_applications: 辩证分析框架
矛盾管理方法论
系统动态平衡思维
对立统一决策模型

name_zh: 大心体物法
definition_zh: '大其心则能体天下之物'，超越感官闻见的有限性，以无限之心体认万物。世人之心止于见闻之狭，圣人尽性不以见闻梏其心。通过扩展心的边界，达到'视天下无一物非我'的境界。
definition_en: 'Expand the great mind and you can comprehend all things under heaven.' Transcend the limited nature of sensory perception; the sage fully actualizes nature without being confined by seeing and hearing. By expanding the mind's boundaries, one reaches the state of 'seeing nothing under heaven as other than myself.'
process_zh: 识别感官闻见的局限性
超越经验认知的边界限制
通过尽性修养扩大心的体认范围
达到'视天下无一物非我'的万物一体境界
process_en: Recognize the limitations of sensory perception
Transcend boundaries of empirical cognition
Expand mind's comprehension through nature-actualizing cultivation
Reach 'seeing all things as self' unified realm
modern_applications: 超越经验主义认知框架
整体性思维训练
跨学科综合理解能力
系统思维的主体修养路径

name_zh: 知礼成性法
definition_zh: 通过'知礼'达到'成性'，以礼仪规范为途径塑造和完善人的道德本性。知礼不是外在约束而是内在修养的方法，通过学习和践行礼仪规范来变化气质、成就圣人品格。
definition_en: 'Know ritual to form character'—using ritual norms as the path to shape and perfect moral nature. Knowing ritual is not external constraint but inner cultivation method; by learning and practicing ritual norms, one transforms temperament and achieves sage character.
process_zh: 学习礼仪规范的内容与精神
将外在礼制内化为道德自觉
通过持续践行改变先天气质
最终成就圣人的完整人格
process_en: Study the content and spirit of ritual norms
Internalize external rituals as moral consciousness
Transform innate temperament through continuous practice
Ultimately achieve complete sage personality
modern_applications: 制度内化的修养路径
礼仪教育的人格塑造功能
规范与自由的辩证统一
道德教育的程序化设计

name_zh: 变化气质法
definition_zh: 人人皆有天地之性（善的本源），但受气质所拘而有善恶之分。通过修养工夫可以'变化气质'，恢复天地之性的本然状态。这是张载人性论的核心：既肯定人人可为圣人的可能性，又强调后天修养的必要性。
definition_en: All people possess Heavenly Nature (the origin of goodness), but are constrained by temperament, leading to good/evil distinctions. Through cultivation practice, one can 'transform temperament' and restore the original state of Heavenly Nature—the core of Zhang Zai's theory: affirming everyone's potential to become sage while emphasizing the necessity of后天 cultivation.
process_zh: 认识自身气质之偏与局限
通过读书明理纠正偏差
以礼制约束日常行为
逐步改变气质恢复天地之性
process_en: Recognize one's own temperament biases and limitations
Correct deviations through reading and understanding principles
Constrain daily behavior with ritual discipline
Gradually transform temperament to restore Heavenly Nature
modern_applications: 自我认知与性格改造
教育中的因材施教原理
习惯养成的系统性方法
个人成长的路径规划

name_zh: 民胞物与法
name_en: Universal Brotherhood Method (All People Are My Brethren)
definition_zh: '民吾同胞，物吾与也'——天下苍生都是我的手足同胞，天地万物都与我有亲缘关系。将仁爱从血缘扩展到全社会乃至整个自然界，构建了最广泛的伦理关怀体系。
definition_en: 'All people are my brothers, all things are my companions'—all beings under heaven are my siblings, and all things in the cosmos share kinship with me. Expanding benevolence from blood ties to all society and even the natural world, constructing the broadest ethical care system.
process_zh: 确立天为父、坤为母的宇宙家庭观
将所有人视为同胞手足
关怀弱势群体（老、幼、孤、寡、残疾）
将伦理关怀扩展到天地万物
process_en: Establish cosmic family view: Heaven as Father, Earth as Mother
View all people as siblings and fellow beings
Care for vulnerable groups (elderly, young, orphaned, widowed, disabled)
Extend ethical concern to all things under heaven
modern_applications: 普世人权理念的中国表达
环境保护的伦理基础
社会包容性设计思维
全球化时代的人类命运共同体意识

name_zh: 横渠四句法
name_en: Four Sentences of Hengqu Method (Cosmic Responsibility Framework)
definition_zh: '为天地立心，为生民立命，为往圣继绝学，为万世开太平'——通过四个'为'字将个人修养与宇宙关怀、历史使命和未来理想融为一体。每个'为'都是主动的担当，而非被动的承受；每个人都可以成为历史的主体。
definition_en: 'Establish heart for Heaven and Earth, establish destiny for the people, continue lost teachings of past sages, open peace for ten thousand generations'—four 'establishing' verbs integrate personal cultivation with cosmic concern, historical mission and future ideal. Each 'for' is active responsibility, not passive acceptance; everyone can become the subject of history.
process_zh: 为天地立心：建立以仁为核心的价值体系
为生民立命：让百姓安身立命、精神有依归
为往圣继绝学：继承发扬儒学传统
为万世开太平：实现理想社会秩序
process_en: Establish heart for Heaven and Earth: build value system centered on benevolence
Establish destiny for people: ensure people have livelihood and spiritual grounding
Continue lost teachings of past sages: inherit and propagate Confucian tradition
Open peace for ten thousand generations: realize ideal social order
modern_applications: 知识分子的使命意识建构
跨代际责任伦理框架
可持续发展的人文基础
全球治理的文明担当

name_zh: 批判佛道法
name_en: Critique of Buddhism and Daoism Method
definition_zh: 站在儒学立场上，从宇宙本体论高度批判佛道二教。指出佛家以'空'为本体、道家以'无'为根源都是错误的，建立了气一元论的替代方案。同时吸收佛道思辨方法，将其纳入儒学体系。
definition_en: Standing on Confucian ground, critiquing Buddhism and Daoism from the level of cosmic ontology. Pointing out that Buddhist 'emptiness' and Daoist 'nothingness' as origins are wrong, while building Qi monism alternative. Simultaneously absorbing Buddhist and Daoist dialectical methods into Confucian system.
process_zh: 识别佛道本体论的根本错误
从体用关系角度批判'空''无'概念
建立气一元论的替代宇宙观
吸收佛道思辨方法丰富儒学
process_en: Identify fundamental errors in Buddhist and Daoist ontology
Critique 'emptiness' and 'nothingness' concepts through substance-function relations
Build Qi monism alternative cosmology
Absorb Buddhist-Daoist dialectical methods to enrich Confucianism
modern_applications: 文化批判与重建方法论
跨思想体系的批判性吸收
意识形态竞争中的理论优势建构
多元文化共存中的立场坚守

name_zh: 井田实践法
definition_zh: '论治人先务，未始不以经界为急'——晚年回到横渠，买地实践《周礼》井田制，划分土地、疏通水渠。将抽象的儒家经济理想转化为具体的制度试验，在关中多地实施井田制改革实验。
definition_en: 'In governing people, nothing comes first—always prioritize land boundary regulation'—in old age returned to Hengqu, bought land to practice the Zhou Dynasty's well-field system, dividing land and clearing irrigation channels. Translating abstract Confucian economic ideals into concrete institutional experiments, implementing well-field system reforms across multiple areas in Guanzhong.
process_zh: 将儒家经济理想具体化为可操作的制度设计
选择横渠作为试验基地
实际划分土地、疏通水渠
观察效果并反思完善
process_en: Translate Confucian economic ideals into operable institutional designs
Select Hengqu as experimental base
Actually divide land and clear irrigation channels
Observe results and reflect for improvement
modern_applications: 政策试点与制度创新的系统方法
理想政策的落地路径设计
基层治理的实验精神
理论与实践的双向验证

name_zh: 关学建构法
definition_zh: 创建'关学'学派，通过讲学、著书、培养弟子实现学术传承。从少年习兵到中年弃武从文，从广读佛道到回归儒学，张载完成了学术路线的完整转型，最终在横渠书院创立了影响关中八百年之久的学派体系。
definition_en: Creating the 'Guan School' through teaching, writing, and cultivating disciples to achieve academic transmission. From youth studying military to middle age abandoning arms for texts, from extensively reading Buddhist and Daoist works to returning to Confucianism, Zhang Zai completed a full academic transformation, ultimately founding at Hengqu Academy the school system that influenced Guanzhong for 800 years.
process_zh: 确立独特的学术方向和理论体系
创建横渠书院作为教学基地
培养弟子传承关学精神
通过著作（正蒙、横渠易说等）确立学派经典
process_en: Establish unique academic direction and theoretical system
Create Hengqu Academy as teaching base
Cultivate disciples to transmit Guan School spirit
Establish school classics through writings (Zheng Meng, Hengqu Yi Shuo, etc.)
modern_applications: 学术学派的建设方法论
思想传承的制度化路径
知识体系的系统化整理
理论创新的组织保障
